_comment: Deploy-artifact size budgets (bytes), enforced by check_deploy_artifact.mts. Re-measured 2026-07-28: worker 125,130 (was 119,980 on 2026-07-26). Cause: the persisted review-base comparison path compiled into the worker — OPFS workspace head recovery and verified review/reconstruction-base probes in rustPipelineRuntime.ts, the persisted-review miss fallback in rustPipelineAuthority.ts, and slot retire/replace in the pool. Sourcemap attribution of the chunk (rustPipelineRuntime 46.7k, plotGenerator 21.5k, opfsArtifactStore 15.4k, timelineViewerRuntime?raw 13.4k, rustPipelineAuthority 10.9k) found no removable duplication: rollup dedupes within the worker build, main/worker sharing is impossible across Vite's separate worker build, and the inlined viewer runtime is required for the per-file Timeline Viewer.html output the worker emits. Worker cap raised 122,000 to 127,000. Total assets 11,035,470; runtime WASM 5,978,073; semantic-index WASM 2,099,237. Runtime and semantic-index WASM remain separate lazy chunks. Budgets retain limited headroom; raising one requires a named cause and a new measurement.
